code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/strict_json.rs: Parses a byte-bounded JSON envelope (default4MiB, explicit caller override), rejects UTF8 BOM and recursively rejects decoded duplicate object keys before constructing serde_json Values. RawValue first validates syntax; exact-number retention depends on the enabled serde_json arbitrary-precision feature. The custom recursion has no separate depth/fuel argument and relies on library parsing behavior; source comment is not independent proof of stack safety. Local tests cover bound separation, duplicate key, private serde-number-key confusion and one integer beyond u64, plus exact capacity boilerplate. Parsing establishes representation validity, not domain semantics.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/immune_fence.r: Renderer explicitly assumes admission-checked caller results. It validates one anchor/no closing marker, identifiers/digest syntax, at most128 input guidance items, configured item<=3/fence<=2048-byte bounds, unique IDs, nonempty guidance and admission-reference object, then selects in supplied order, records omissions and refuses missing required IDs. It hashes sorted-key request/rendering/binding data under a declared serde profile, not JCS. It does not authenticate admission references, review guidance, bind actual rule/catalog bytes, or prevent arbitrary prose in the reviewed-text field. Payload cloning/hashing precede resource gates, and guidance/metadata allocation has no local total-input ceiling. Only capacity tests are local; no prompt-provider calls were made.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/stabilizer/mod: Declares the bounded commuting-Pauli solver/checker API and public term/case/outcome DTOs, with maxima8qubits/24terms and deterministic input-order basis certificate contract. DTO construction/deserialization alone is not validation; exported solve/check parse JSON through the input owner. The mathematical claim concerns a finite Hamiltonian of supplied Pauli penalties, not empirical physics, a general noncommuting solver or benchmark success. Local tests only exercise shared capacity arithmetic. The advertised totality depends on input/parser/Pauli/arithmetic dependencies inspected separately; no universal panic-freedom proof is supplied here.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/stabilizer/inp: Admits object cases with1..8qubits and<=24terms; parses Pauli words through core_quantum_physics, checks length, creates fallback term IDs, rejects duplicate IDs, nonnegative i64 rational weights with positive denominator, and target±1. Supports aliases/defaults and tolerates unknown fields; simultaneous aliases are selected by precedence rather than checked for contradiction. u64 qubit count is cast to usize before the bound, so interpretation is architecture-dependent on32-bit targets. Pauli text is parsed before length admission. No commutativity is checked until solve. All local tests are shared capacity tests, not admission edge vectors.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/stabilizer/sol: Parses the bounded input, rejects any anticommuting pair, extracts a deterministic GF2-independent generator basis, solves decomposition masks and reconstructs the full Pauli multiplication phase. Enumerates<=2^8 assignments of generator eigenvalues, accumulates nonnegative penalties with BigRational, and computes degeneracy as number of minimizers times2^(n-k). Unrepresentable final i64 energy limbs produce typed ENERGY_WIDTH_EXCEEDED rather than rounded/overflowed energy; empty terms give the full2^n zero-energy space. Correctness depends on isotropic Pauli independence, phase multiplication and equal rank-eigenspace dimensions; this is finite exact computation under those algebraic premises, not a formal proof or independent physical calibration. Internal checked-invariant helpers panic if dependency invariants fail. Only capacity tests occur locally.
code/rust/pfp_runtime/src/stabilizer/cer: Candidate checker binds result ID/status, reruns the same native solver, compares exact energy/degeneracy and exact deterministic basis/decomposition rows, and requires the complete minimizer multiset. It separately verifies an OUT_OF_SCOPE witness actually names anticommuting terms; UNKNOWN must match the native refusal code. Phase/sign aliases must agree; rational energy comparison accepts equivalent unreduced positive-denominator pairs. This is genuine candidate-bound recomputation, but is not an algorithmically independent checker: shared solver defects could pass both. It accepts extra JSON fields, does not authenticate provenance, and the stated any-input totality is not formally established. Only shared capacity tests are in this file; no broader suite was rerun in this phase.
